note: Phase 26: expands compressed-KV (q8/q5/adaptive) architecture support from llama-only to llama+qwen2, backed by two independent, real layers of evidence -- see docs/compat-expansion.md for the full narrative. All 8 rows below are REAL (live membrane-run product-path invocations against the local Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct fixture, this exact commit's binary); none are SIMULATED. A separate, non-row SOURCE_PROVEN finding (architectural equivalence between LLM_ARCH_LLAMA and LLM_ARCH_QWEN2 in the pinned llama.cpp's own KV-cache construction code) is documented in docs/compat-expansion.md, not restated as JSON here -- it is a claim about source code, not a measurement, so it does not fit this file's row schema.

host.note: same real Pop!_OS 24.04 dev machine as every prior phase (AMD Ryzen 5 5600H, real NVIDIA GTX 1650 Vulkan device Vulkan1), 5.6 GiB RAM -- every row is device-scoped, never generalized.
